title: Certificate issuance and approved trust stores need deployment evidence
remediation: Deployment PKI operators and component maintainers inventory assessed certificates, issuing authorities and trust stores. Verify approved issuance, renewal and revocation processes and collect the effective trust-anchor set for each deployment path. Use approved fixture certificates to verify accepted and refused trust decisions. Keep actual private keys out of assessment artifacts.

milestones.title: Collect the approved authority and trust-store inventory, issuance and lifecycle sample, and scoped certificate verification results
